gold_decisions.identity_explanation: Both entries concern interpolation estimates, but the gold defect is that a global dG-star seminorm is asserted for a local interpolant using only a local norm, leaving the expression undefined without a global extension. ISSUE-001 instead diagnoses failure of the interpolation lemma at the borderline regularity condition q=d/2 for the estimate of I_h p_tt-p_tt. It does not recognise the local-versus-global domain mismatch or the missing global seminorm estimate.

The gold defect concerns insufficient time regularity of acoustic and concentration source terms for applying Picard–Lindelöf and obtaining the claimed classical solution regularity. ISSUE-001 concerns a spatial interpolation estimate for p_tt at a borderline Sobolev/interpolation condition. The shared downstream well-posedness consequences do not establish recognition of the source-regularity hypothesis failure.

The gold defect is the absence of an approximation or energy control condition on the discrete initial concentration u_{0,h}, which invalidates the claimed initial-time concentration error rate. ISSUE-001 instead diagnoses a spatial interpolation regularity failure for the pressure second-derivative term. It does not recognise the uncontrolled initial discrete concentration or the missing initial-energy hypothesis.
